about_short_description.short_description: Instalab is a healthcare company that provides medical testing, medication, and health consultations.

product.name: Medical Testing Platform
product.description: A platform that recommends and facilitates medical tests based on individual factors like age, sex, and family history, including scheduling and sample collection options.

product.name: Personal Health Concierge Service
product.description: A service that explains medical test results to patients and connects them with relevant medical specialists if needed.

product.name: Longevity Physician Access
product.description: A service offering direct consultations with longevity-focused physicians for health advice and management, available for a fee.

product.name: Instalab Blood Panel
product.description: A comprehensive blood test panel offered annually to members for monitoring various health markers.

product.name: The Galleri Test
product.description: A blood-based multi-cancer early detection test that screens for over 50 types of cancer by analyzing cell-free DNA methylation patterns.
